evidence.quote: if (from > to) throw new DomainError(400, "from must not be after to");

rules.statement: A report's start date must not be after its end date.
rules.subject: report date range (from vs to)

rules.statement: Only paid bookings count towards tickets sold, members admitted and hire income in a report.
rules.subject: booking status counted in report

rules.statement: Admissions on bookings that carry a membership number count as members admitted, not as tickets sold.
rules.subject: booking admission classification

rules.statement: Hire income is the number of hired items times a fixed hire price per item (HIRE_PRICE_CENTS).
rules.subject: equipment hire income

rules.statement: A weekly report covers the Monday-to-Sunday week (7 days) that contains the given date.
rules.subject: weekly report period
